verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a background job/task orchestration platform; the evidence pack contains no privacy policy, data-training opt-out, or AI-training-usage statement of any kind. Self-hosting (docs-9, docs-30) gives infrastructure control but does not itself constitute a documented 'no training on your data' commitment. Missing for 10: any explicit data-training opt-out policy, privacy/DPA language addressing AI model training use, or vendor statement on this topic.
